sources.interpretation: Funatlas aggregates multiple animals with optional identity merging. Fconn stores per-recording fits; ExponentialConvolution represents sums of convolved decaying exponentials. A prospective regularized linear quadrature comparator is not an exact implementation of author symbolic exponential fitting.

paper_observations: The paper records optogenetic stimulation every 30 seconds with whole-brain calcium imaging. Published analysis interpolates missing points, removes outliers, uses causal smoothing, and defines F0 from 30 seconds before stimulation. Kernel fitting uses unsmoothed traces but selects events with detected source and receiver responses. Those choices do not license copying a pooled atlas or responder-only sample into this task, whose packet has only 10 seconds of receiver prehistory and requires retained original samples, missingness and failures. The paper includes mutant and spontaneous analyses; DANDI metadata alone does not establish their full inclusion.

facts: Volume timestamps average original framesDetails timestamps over zOfFrame frame groups. Do not replace them with uniform sampling.
ROI label frame must be unique; ref_index and ROI count are validated against brains.json. neuropal_ids may be blank.
Base{Channel}Signal restores original nan_mask; Interpolated{Channel}Signal is distinct. If never interpolated, {Channel}Signal is emitted. Units are n.a.
Weighted-mask voxel weights are unavailable; converter retains centroids, so exact imaging-mask reconstruction is not established.
Lines82-83 default subject_id to YYMMDD unless a subject_info override is present.
Line174 hardcodes genotype WT; metadata field alone is not verified condition provenance.
Missing source folders warn and return None, so successful converter completion does not prove full acquisition coverage.
Stimulus start uses frameCount joined into framesDetails timestamps.
Stimulus duration is hardcoded0.5s with a mutant0.3s TODO; power hardcoded1.2mW.

target_pumpprobe_id is taken from targets_manually_located.txt; nonpositive values become NaN. Segmentation ROI IDs begin0, so mapping of original target0 requires independent evidence, not automatic correction.

preserved_gates: Complete acquisition/pair inventory and OSF-to-DANDI genotype/spontaneous-scope reconciliation.
Immutable content digests and authentic trace schema/clock/unit/label checks; asset UUIDs are identities, not content checksum proofs.
Rights and software dependencies for each acquired component; DANDI CC-BY-4.0 and converter BSD-3-Clause verified, OSF rights/version and full dependencies unresolved.
Protected answer custody, public-label exposure and outer-assessment design.
Reference qualification, all negative controls and independent grader review before any scientific claim.
DANDI asset list includes113 imaging but only110 segmentation files; labels sub-20,sub-23,sub-33 have no segmentation partner. Trace-only complete release coverage remains unresolved.
